Name: More Giant Crops
Author: spacechase0
Description:
[b]More Giant Crops[/b] lets you add new giant crops.

[b][size=5]Install[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url].
[*]Unzip the mod folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[b][size=5]Use[/size][/b]
[b][size=3]Adding giant crops[/size][/b]
This mod doesn't include any crops by default; you need to download the textures you want to use. You can find available downloads by expanding the [i]Requirements[/i] section above, and checking the [i]Mods requiring this file[/i] list.

More Giant Crops will create an [font=Courier New]assets[/font] folder the first time you run it. You can add any number of giant crops as [font=Courier New].png[/font] images to this folder. For example, this adds garlic and parsnips as giant crops:
[code]? Mods/
? MoreGiantCrops/
? assets/
? 24.png
? 248.png
[/code]

[b][size=3]For mod authors[/size][/b]
The name of each file must be the crop's produce ID (i.e. the key in [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Object_data][font=Courier New]Data\ObjectInformation[/font][/url], or the [i]index of harvest[/i] field in [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Crop_data][font=Courier New]Data\Crops[/font][/url]). The images must be exactly 48 pixels wide by 64 pixels high.

[b][size=5]Compatibility[/size][/b]
Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.5.5+ on Linux/macOS/Windows, both single-player and multiplayer.

[b][size=5]See also[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://github.com/spacechase0/StardewValleyMods/blob/develop/MoreGiantCrops/docs/release-notes.md#release-notes]Release notes[/url]
[*][url=https://github.com/spacechase0/StardewValleyMods]Source code[/url]
[/list]
